response.sql: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share FROM station_counts), above_average AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) AS difference_above_average FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY difference_above_average DESC) AS position FROM above_average) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, difference_above_average FROM ranked WHERE position <= 10 ORDER BY difference_above_average DESC, observstation;
